description: Loose machine debris. Everywhere, worth almost nothing, and the reason you walk one more corridor.
Intact structural framing pulled from a dead Goliath. The first material that makes a fort look deliberate.
Refined armour stock. Heavy, slow to produce, and the difference between a wall and a delay.
Magnetic plasma metal alloy. Found, never forged. Wrapped around a primary node it swallows the signature and buys you time you did not earn.
